definition.name: Exact production Write old counterexample and eight bounded controls

steps.name: Check exact projection and strict counterexample reader
Authenticate one official reference compiler
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-write-reference-tools"
test ! -e "$out"
mkdir "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "ecbadb99091a3f46e31f5f934b068b1864eafa7995211b39eaddf76996045fe5  $out/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/go.tar.gz" -C "$out"
echo "$out/go/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
